title: 第八十八章 太狂了第八十七章 冷君的苦衷
slug: 火影之银色王座第九十四章恶魔
content_zh:
大蛇丸喜欢研究，那完全是因为父母的死！可一开始大蛇丸怎么也没有用活人拿来做研究的！后来是长老团命令大蛇丸去做的！当时长老团的长老们说，出事了，他们担着！
可是后来事情败露了，长老团却拿大蛇丸当了替死鬼，木叶完全不听大蛇丸解释，于是大蛇丸只好叛逃出了木叶！
大蛇丸将自己的经历如实的讲了出来，三代不由恨恨的看了自己身后的长老们一眼！而其他忍者也没想到原来大蛇丸叛逃的真相，是这个样子的！
长老团的那些长老们更是脸色铁青！没想到这个秘密也被揭露了出来，让他们心中憎恨无比！
“有证据吗？你们有证据吗？”被波风冥帝踩在脚下的团藏，还是死不承认！
“证据啊！”波风冥帝冷冷一笑“那就请团藏你这老狗交出证据吧。”
“什么？”被人叫老狗？团藏正要发作，可波风冥帝却是手中嘶鸣雷电，使用出了雷切！
“噼！”雷电一闪而过！
“啊！.....”接着团藏，便是痛苦的叫了起来！他的右臂，他的右眼，都被波风冥帝的雷电给劈了下来！
波风冥帝拿着那右眼，右臂，呵呵道“这就是证据了！”说着，将绑在手臂上的绷带给解开了，露出了一只苍白的手臂，上面满是鲜红的三勾玉写轮眼，总共有十二只。
“你这个该死的！”看着写轮眼，佐助拳头紧握，眼神愤怒，最后愤怒的吼了起来！
写轮眼！宇智波一族的写轮眼！
那些族人死了，眼睛还要被活生生的挖下来！佐助咬牙切齿，恨不得将团藏给杀了！
其他忍者也没想到团藏做出了这种丧心病狂的事情来！波风冥帝看着佐助道“佐助，写轮眼，我先帮你冰遁封印起来！这一只万花筒写轮眼，我是为鼬预备的。”
波风冥帝的话让佐助愣了一下，低声道“这是什么意思？”
“万花筒写轮眼进化为永恒万花筒的办法，我以前和你说过了吧！”波风冥帝呵呵笑道“这是止水的万花筒写轮眼！我想没有比它更适合鼬的写轮眼了。”
“止水？这是止水的？”佐助吃惊的道。对于宇智波止水这个名字，佐助一点也不陌生！
宇智波止水，这可是宇智波一族的幻术传奇人物！有着瞬身止水的美誉！
“止水的左眼，在鼬的手里，如果再加上这右眼！那么鼬就会有一双完整的永恒万花筒写轮眼了！”波风冥帝道。
佐助一脸呆愣的点了点头，没想到波风冥帝连这些都知道？如今在佐助眼里，波风冥帝完全深不可测！

“好了，大蛇丸，你可以退下了。”波风冥帝淡淡的道。
“好！”大蛇丸点了点头，就是退到了波风冥帝身后了。看见堂堂冷君大蛇丸居然屈服于波风冥帝命令之下，让的三代等忍者又是一阵错愕！
波风冥帝，实在给他们太多惊叹，太多惊愕了！
一旁的大名愣愣的看着眼前所发生的！他都不知道该说什么了！看波风冥帝还有其他事情要解决，大名心中就松了一口气！
只要等到那个老者前来！那么大名觉得一定可以灭了波风冥帝！
而波风冥帝对于大名的想法也不是不了解，已经猜到了一些，可是波风冥帝对于自己的实力相当的有自信，火影世界之中，目前能让波风冥帝看重的也就只有全盛时期宇智波鼬，全盛时期漩涡长门，面具人阿飞，还有宇智波斑，千手柱间了！
其他人，在波风冥帝看来，来几个，死几个！团藏被拿去了右眼，右臂，鲜血直流，波风冥帝便是一脚狠狠的踢了出去，摩擦过了空气，便是将团藏踢飞了！
而三代已经不知道该说什么了，愣愣的站在那里！他已经彻底被打击到了！
而其他长老则是恶狠狠的看着波风冥帝！不由心中暗想到！波风冥帝，你也太小看三代，太小看大名了！他们的隐藏实力可是不小的！你迟早要付出代价！
波风冥帝看长老团那些人的脸色，想都不用想，就知道他们想的到底是什么了！波风冥帝便是冷冷笑道“你们几个在想些什么，别以为我不知道啊！我和你们说吧，我可没有小看三代，大名啊！”
听到这句话，三代，大名两个人脸色好看了一些！心想，波风冥帝虽然狂，但也不至于无可救药了！但紧接着波风冥帝又是一笑道“我没把他们两个人放在眼里，又哪里来的小看他们呢？”
什么？
三代皱起来了眉头！
大名更是一脸阴沉！他们两个人都是火影世界响当当的人物，没想到有人根本不把他们放在眼里？？？
卡卡西等人面面相觑！波风冥帝是不是太狂了？？？真的有那么强的实力，可以不将他们放在眼里？？？佐助和鸣人互相看了对方一眼，波风冥帝很强，他们两个人知道，但是他们也不认为波风冥帝可以强到，无视火之国的地步！
“你们都觉得我口气太大了吧，觉得我太自负了？？？”看卡卡西他们的神色，波风冥帝便是已经猜测到了他们的想法！
卡卡西等人沉默了，而只有大蛇丸舔了舔舌头“不，冥帝君，我认为你有说这句话的资格。”大蛇丸可是知道波风冥帝的斩魄刀其中一个能力镜花水月的！
只要有那个在！可以说波风冥帝完全立于不败之地！火之国又怎么样？千军万马又怎么样？直接催眠一下，那些人完全就是任凭宰杀的命了！
“波风冥帝，你....你太狂了！”大名怒吼了起来！接着便是挥了挥手！守护忍十二士剩下的十一人便是猛然的站在了波风冥帝的面前！他们腰下部位都系着征十二忍的火之图章！
“你们十一个废物！一起上吧。”波风冥帝淡淡的道。一旁阿斯玛听到这句话，不由惊愕的道“不可以！守护忍十二士有十二星座大阵，相传那是六道仙人七杀阵之一！到时候他们的力量，可不是一加一等于二这么简单了！”

content_en:
Orochimaru likes to study, it's entirely because of the death of his parents! But in the beginning Orochimaru never used living people for research! Later, the elders ordered Orochimaru to do it! At that time, the elders of the body of elders said that if something happened, they would take the responsibility!
But later the matter was revealed, and the elders used Orochimaru as a scapegoat. Konoha did not listen to Orochimaru's explanation at all, so Orochimaru had to defect from Konoha!
Orochimaru told his experience truthfully, and the third generation couldn't help but look at the elders behind him hatefully! And other ninjas didn't expect that the truth behind Orochimaru's defection would be like this!
The elders in the elders' group were even more pale! Unexpectedly, this secret was also revealed, which made them extremely hateful!
"Is there any evidence? Do you have any evidence?" Danzo, who was trampled under the feet of Emperor Namikaze, still refused to admit it!
"Evidence!" Namikaze Hades smiled coldly, "Then please Danzo, you old dog, hand over the evidence."
"What?" Being called an old dog? Danzo was about to have an attack, but Namikaze Hades roared with thunder and lightning in his hand and used Raikiri!
"Crack!" Thunder and lightning flashed past!
"Ah!..." Then Danzo screamed in pain! His right arm and his right eye were chopped off by Namikaze Hades' lightning!
Namikaze Hade took the right eye and right arm and exclaimed, "This is the evidence!" As he spoke, he untied the bandage on his arm, revealing a pale arm covered with bright red three magatama sharingan eyes, a total of twelve.
"Damn you!" Looking at the Sharingan, Sasuke clenched his fists with angry eyes, and finally roared angrily!
Sharingan! The Sharingan of the Uchiha clan!
Those tribesmen were dead, and their eyes had to be gouged out alive! Sasuke gritted his teeth and wanted to kill Danzo!
The other ninjas didn't expect Danzo to do such a crazy thing! Namikaze Hades looked at Sasuke and said, "Sasuke, Sharingan, I will help you seal the ice escape first! I prepared this Mangekyo Sharingan for Itachi."
The words of Emperor Namikaze made Sasuke stunned for a moment, and he whispered, "What does this mean?"
"I've told you how to evolve the Mangekyō Sharingan into the Eternal Mangekyō before!" Namikaze Hades laughed and said, "This is Shisui's Mangekyō Sharingan! I don't think there is any Sharingan that is more suitable for Itachi."
"Shisui? Is this Shisui's?" Sasuke said in surprise. Sasuke is no stranger to the name Uchiha Shisui!
Uchiha Shisui, this is the genjutsu legend of the Uchiha clan! It has the reputation of instantly stopping water!
"Shisui's left eye is in Itachi's hand. If you add this right eye to it! Then Itachi will have a complete pair of eternal Mangekyō Sharingan!" Emperor Namikaze said.
Sasuke nodded blankly, but he didn't expect Namikaze Hades to even know this? Now in Sasuke's eyes, Namikaze Hades is completely unfathomable!
"Okay, Orochimaru, you can retreat." Namikaze Hades said calmly.
"Okay!" Orochimaru nodded and retreated behind Namikaze Hades. Seeing the dignified and cold Lord Orochimaru actually succumbing to Namikaze Hades' orders, the Third Generation and other ninjas were shocked again!
Namikaze Hades really gave them too much exclamation and astonishment!
The daimyo on the side stared blankly at what was happening in front of him! He didn't even know what to say! Seeing that Emperor Namikaze had other things to solve, the daimyo breathed a sigh of relief!
Just wait until the old man comes! Then the daimyo feels that he can definitely destroy Namikaze Hades!
It's not that Namikaze Hades doesn't understand the Daimyo's thoughts, he has already guessed a few things, but Namikaze Hades is quite confident in his own strength. In the world of Naruto, the only ones that Namikaze Hades value at the moment are Uchiha Itachi in his prime, Uzumaki Nagato in his prime, the masked man Hi, and Uchi.Haubara, Senju Hashirama is here!
In the eyes of Namikaze Hades, others will come and die! Danzo's right eye and right arm were taken away, and blood was flowing out. Namikaze Hades kicked him out hard, rubbing the air, and kicked Danzo away!
And the third generation didn't know what to say anymore, he just stood there in a daze! He has been completely shocked!
The other elders looked at Namikaze Hades fiercely! I couldn't help but think to myself! Emperor Namikaze, you underestimate the third generation and the great name too much! Their hidden strength is quite big! Sooner or later you have to pay the price!
Emperor Namikaze looked at the faces of the elders and knew what they were thinking without even thinking about it! Namikaze Hades sneered and said, "Don't think I don't know what you guys are thinking! Let me tell you, I don't underestimate the third generation, your name!"
Hearing these words, the third generation and the daimyo looked better! I thought to myself that although Emperor Namikaze is crazy, he is not hopeless! But then Namikaze Hades smiled again and said, "I don't take them seriously, so how can I underestimate them?"
What?
The third generation frowned!
The daimyo looked even more gloomy! Both of them are well-known figures in the world of fire, but you didn't expect that some people didn't take them seriously at all? ? ?
Kakashi and others looked at each other! Is Emperor Namikaze too crazy? ? ? Are they really so powerful that they can be ignored? ? ? Sasuke and Naruto looked at each other. The two of them knew that Namikaze Hades was very strong, but they didn't think that Namikaze Hades could be strong enough to ignore the Fire Nation!
"You all think I'm too loud, think I'm too conceited???" Looking at Kakashi's and the others' expressions, Namikaze Hades has already guessed what they were thinking!
Kakashi and the others were silent, but Orochimaru licked his tongue, "No, Hades-kun, I think you have the qualifications to say this." Orochimaru knew that one of Namikaze Hades' Zanpakutos has the ability Kyoka Suigetsu!
As long as that is there! It can be said that Namikaze Hades is completely invincible! What about the Fire Nation? So what if there are thousands of troops? Just hypnotize them, and those people are completely ready to be slaughtered!
"Emperor Namikaze, you...you are too crazy!" the daimyo roared! Then he waved his hand! The remaining eleven of the twelve guardian ninjas suddenly stood in front of Namikaze Hades! They all wear fire seals that conquer the twelve ninjas below their waists!
"You eleven losers! Come on together." Namikaze Hades said calmly. When Asuma heard this, he couldn't help but said in shock, "No! The twelve guardian ninjas have a twelve constellation formation. It is said that it is one of the seven killing formations of the Six Paths Sage! By then, their power will not be as simple as one plus one equals two!"
